source: WildJar + CallRail APIs (no native BQ export - schema designed by us)
note: Unified fact with a `platform` discriminator ('wildjar'|'callrail'); shared concepts mapped to canonical columns, platform-specific fields NULLable, remainder preserved in wildjar_raw_json / callrail_raw_json. All ids STRING, all durations INT64 seconds, call_date DATE is account-local and is the partition column. Every table carries account_id STRING and ends with _DATA_DATE / _LATEST_DATE.

tables.name: calls_Call
tables.grain: one row per call (inbound or outbound) across WildJar + CallRail; PK call_uid = platform || '|' || call_id (WildJar uuid / CallRail id); partition call_date, cluster (account_id, call_tracking_number, attribution_source); MUTABLE - MERGE on call_uid over the 30-35 day trailing re-pull window, never append-only

tables.name: calls_TrackingNumber
tables.grain: one row per tracking number per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot); PK (platform, number_id, _DATA_DATE); filter _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE for current pool state; join calls on call_tracking_number = number_phone

tables.name: calls_DailyStats
tables.grain: account_id x platform x segments_date x segments_source x segments_medium x segments_campaign x segments_tracking_number x segments_tracking_source x segments_direction x segments_device; recomputed from calls_Call over the trailing re-pull window, never incrementally added to
